title: rosa maximowicziana var. adenocalyx
intro: Rosa maximowicziana var. adenocalyx, commonly known as Adenocalyx rose, is a variety of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Adenocalyx rose include its use as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and atherosclerosis. The bioactive constituents of Adenocalyx rose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
